description: This file defines the HibernateFormDAO class, which provides Hibernate-specific implementations of data access methods for Form and related entities within the OpenMRS platform. It includes CRUD operations, complex queries, and utility functions related to forms, form fields, resources, and associated entities.

classes.name: HibernateFormDAO
classes.description: Hibernate-specific implementation of FormDAO, managing form-related entities and queries in a Hibernate context.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Assigns the Hibernate SessionFactory to be used for database operations.

methods.name: saveForm
methods.description: Persists or updates a Form entity in the database.

methods.name: duplicateForm
methods.description: Creates a copy of the given Form entity in the database.

methods.name: deleteForm
methods.description: Deletes the specified Form from the database.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Retrieves a Form by its ID.

methods.name: getFormFields
methods.description: Fetches the list of FormField entities associated with a specific Form.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Finds Fields matching a search term.

methods.name: getFieldsByConcept
methods.description: Gets Fields linked to a specific Concept.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Fetches a Field by its ID.

methods.name: getAllFields
methods.description: Retrieves all Fields, with optional inclusion of retired fields.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Fetches a FieldType by its ID.

methods.name: getAllFieldTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all FieldTypes, with optional inclusion of retired.

methods.name: getFormField
methods.description: Fetches a FormField by its ID.

methods.name: getFormField
methods.description: Retrieves a FormField based on form, concept, ignored fields, and force flag.

methods.name: getFormsContainingConcept
methods.description: Returns all Forms that contain a specific Concept.

methods.name: saveField
methods.description: Saves or updates a Field entity.

methods.name: deleteField
methods.description: Deletes a specified Field.

methods.name: saveFormField
methods.description: Persists or updates a FormField.

methods.name: deleteFormField
methods.description: Removes a FormField from the database.

methods.name: getAllFormFields
methods.description: Retrieves all FormField entities.

methods.name: getFieldByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a Field using its UUID.

methods.name: getFieldAnswerByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a FieldAnswer using its UUID.

methods.name: getFieldTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a FieldType by UUID.

methods.name: getFieldTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves a FieldType by its name.

methods.name: saveFieldType
methods.description: Saves or updates a FieldType.

methods.name: deleteFieldType
methods.description: Deletes a specified FieldType.

methods.name: getFormFieldByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a FormField by UUID.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Retrieves a Form by name and version.

methods.name: getForms
methods.description: Fetches a list of forms based on partial name, publication status, encounter types, retirement status, form fields, and other parameters.

methods.name: getFormCount
methods.description: Returns the count of forms matching search criteria.

methods.name: getFormByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Form by UUID.

methods.name: getFormByName
methods.description: Fetches a list of forms with a specific name.

methods.name: saveFormResource
methods.description: Saves or updates a FormResource.

methods.name: deleteFormResource
methods.description: Deletes a FormResource.

methods.name: getFormResource
methods.description: Fetches a FormResource by ID.

methods.name: getFormResourceByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a FormResource by UUID.

methods.name: getFormResourcesForForm
methods.description: Retrieves all resources associated with a specific Form.
